items.label: Material
items.value: Sweaters for women is made of Viscose, Nylon and Polyester. Womens long sleeve tops is soft, lightweight and breathable. Super soft knit and perfectly tailored fit bring you a very comfortable wearing experience.

items.label: Features
items.value: This womens sweaters features v neck, a stylish hollow out design for a relaxed, comfortable fit and a fashionable look. The crochet knit adds texture and charm to the overall design.

items.label: Versatile
items.value: Womens long sleeve sweaters pair effortlessly with jeans, skirts, or tailored trousers for a sophisticated look year-round. Wear it with a coat, blazer, or jacket in fall and winter for a refined office look, or with casual jeans in spring and summer for a relaxed, effortless look.

items.label: Occasion
items.value: Women's lightweight knit crochet pullover is perfect for fall and early winter, and also suitable for daily wear, vacation, work, business, school, teachers, casual dressy events, date night, and even spring summer wear.

items.label: Note
items.value: Hand wash recommended. Machine washable in cold water on a gentle cycle, hang or dry, please refer to the Wiholl size chart to choose the most suitable size. Colors may vary—best in natural light (D65).

items.label: Product Care Instructions
items.value: Hand Wash Recommended/ lf machine washing, use a gentle cycle with cold water and mild detergent.
